thread:
olivia: Heads up — vendor (NexusParts) emailed: ETA for reordered H100 batch slipped to 12 weeks, but they can do a partial RMA swap from a near-term pool. Asking if we want air expedite for 8/40 units (extra $1.8k/unit) or split-surface with 10 urgent via air and rest sea. Also flagged thermal scare on one pallet, might require depot inspection.
sam: Oof, 12 weeks kills our Q2 deck. How many do we need to keep Dedicated capacity up?
jordan: We're down 24 GPUs in EU-west pool. If we don't cover, some pipelines drop to single-instance. Need at least 10 to avoid SLO violations.
olivia: Right now ask is: authorize air for 10 (priority), accept sea for remaining 30, or push for vendor credit/discount on the longer lead. Vendor offered 5% credit on invoice if we take sea-only.
maria: Can we tolerate 10 air? Cost math: 10 * +$1.8k = +$18k this shipment vs. estimated $90k invoice. Compared to SLA impact (engineering time + customer-facing degradation), feels reasonable.
toby: Two asks: 1) can vendor split AWB so we can route EU units to FRA depot and rest to NY hub? 2) need HSN/tariff for customs pre-clear.
olivia: Asked vendor for split AWB and HS code. They replied with provisional AWBs but flagged customs hold potential due to "thermal variance" note. Vendor offered to include photo evidence and inspection certificates.
shipbot: Shipment created by NexusParts: AWB-EU: NA123456789, AWB-US: NA987654321. Provisional ETA (air): 5 business days (EU), 7 business days (US). Sea ETA: ~26 days.
jordan: Can we do cross-dock at FRA to avoid depot queue? Last time cross-dock saved 48h. Also need serial manifest format ASAP — last swap had mismatches.
maria: Send vendor our manifest template: `manifest_v2.csv` columns: `serial,model,fw_version,sku,received_ts` — insist on exact column order.
olivia: Vendor acknowledged manifest template and agreed to provide pictures + pre-clear docs. They're asking if we'll accept a partial refurb pool for 6 units (refurb grade A, 90-day warranty) to speed up. Thoughts?
sam: Refurb A is okay if warranty covers production SLA. Need SKUs and burn-in logs. Also confirm KV cache health tests post-install.
toby: Also ask vendor to provide HSN 8471.70 or correct classification. If customs reclass, we eat duties. Push vendor to cover misclassification fines.
jordan: Operational ask: label the EU AWB with depot tag `FRA-CROSSDOCK-PRIORITY`, and ship with insured value note `INSURED: FULL` — we can't risk partial loss.
olivia: Negotiated: vendor will air-ship 8 new + 2 refurb (all A-grade) to EU, 10 air-new to US. Rest sea. They're offering $20k credit if we accept 30 sea units + photo evidence + depot inspection on arrival.
maria: Can finance accept $20k offset vs immediate $18k air premium? Sounds like a wash, but $20k is delayed credit — need to log as credit memo.
sam: Technical veto: we need at least 2 new GPUs in EU immediately for cluster parity. If vendor can guarantee 2-day hold for priority unpacking and burn-in at FRA depot, approve air for those.
olivia: Confirmed vendor will prioritize 2 units for FRA burn-in lane (48h). Also agreed to add serial manifest in `manifest_v2.csv` and include depot inspection photos within 24h of arrival.
jordan: Please add routing note in ops tickets: `/ops create ticket: FRA-burnin-priority, assign infra-team` and tag `impact:dedicated`.
toby: One more: vendor insists on HSN 8542.31 in their paperwork — that's wrong for compute cards. If customs flags, ask vendor to backstop duties. I'm adding vendor legal in thread.
olivia: Adding vendor-legal contact (cc'd via email). Also asked for initial AWB ETA updates.
shipbot: Update: AWB-EU NA123456789 status: in-air, est arrive FRA 2026-04-05 09:00 CET. AWB-US NA987654321 status: in-transit est arrive JFK 2026-04-07. Sea manifest for remainder expected 2026-04-28.
maria: Cool. Finance: I'll prep credit memo draft for $20k and hold approval until we confirm photos + manifests.
jordan: Infra ops: I'll queue burn-in slot for the two FRA units. Toby — can you confirm you have the `kv-cache` test harness ready?
toby: Yes, kv-cache harness v1.3 patched to log latencies >1ms. I'll run the full suite during burn-in and post-install.
olivia: Final decision: authorize air for 20 (10 EU, 10 US) including 2 FRA-priority new units; accept sea for rest with $20k credit conditional on photos + correct manifest + vendor indemnity for customs misclassification. Approving now so vendor can book.
sam: Approved from infra. We will monitor SLOs and open a rollback ticket if error rate increases after install.
jordan: Thanks — I'll update the rollout plan and postmortem template if anything slips.
maria: I'll track the credit memo and flag if vendor delays documentation beyond 48h.
olivia: Thanks everyone. @vendor-legal please confirm indemnity and send signed amendment. :thumbsup:
